description: Exercise Stone branching and subscript access for a small record-selection task.

script.source:
items = [{"name": "alpha", "score": 72}, {"name": "beta", "score": 91}, {"name": "gamma", "score": 88}]
best = items[1]
runner_up = items[-1]
if best["score"] > runner_up["score"] and best["name"] != runner_up["name"]:
    emit({"selected": best["name"], "score": best["score"], "margin": "positive"})
else:
    emit({"selected": runner_up["name"], "score": runner_up["score"], "margin": "fallback"})
